notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed typos – Various text errors across dialogues and UI have been corrected.
 Fixed NPC animation bug – NPCs no longer continue staring at you after death. (Creepy, we know.)
 Fixed visual bug in the main menu – No more weird glitches when navigating options.
 Fixed "That's a Wrapped" achievement - Now you really need to solve all the puzzles to unlock this one.
 Fixed Linguini moving into farts on the 1st puzzle of the 6th world.



Audio Improvements:

 Music polish – Smoother transitions, better balancing, and overall enhanced soundtrack quality.
 Added sound effect – Trapdoor now has a well deserved sound effect when activated. Watch your step!


Thanks for playing, and keep holding your nose out there!

— Team Rataiada
